## DE analysis; protein-coding using all protein_cdoing genes as size factors; 
## sncRNA (w/o tRNAs) using all sncRNAs as size factors
## This section is stored in "IBC.image"
```{r, echo=FALSE}
dat<-read.delim("all_IBC_cleanedup.counts")
coldata <- data.frame(c(rep("Healthy",4),rep("F_nonIBC",4),rep("nonIBC",4),rep("IBC",10),
                        rep(c(rep("Healthy",16),rep("nonIBC",6),rep("IBC",10)),2)),
                      c(rep("H",4),rep("NA",4),
                        rep(c("N","P"),2),
                        c("P","N","N",rep("P",6),"N"),
                        rep(c(rep("H",16),
                        c("N","P","P","N","N","P"),
                        c("P","N","N",rep("P",6),"N")),2)),
                      c(rep("Forzen Tissue",8),rep("FFPE",14),rep("PBMC",32),rep("Plasma",32)),
                      colnames(dat)[2:87],
                      row.names=colnames(dat)[2:87])
colnames(coldata) <- c("Disease","HR","Tissue","Name")
coldata$Disease<-factor(coldata$Disease,levels=c("Healthy","F_nonIBC","nonIBC","IBC"))
coldata$HR<-factor(coldata$HR,levels=c("H","NA","N","P"))
#mRNA DE
pro_dat<-dat[dat$Type=="Protein coding",]
FFPE_dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = pro_dat[,2:23],
                                   colData = coldata[1:22,],design = ~Disease)
PBMC_dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = pro_dat[,24:55],
                                   colData = coldata[23:54,],design = ~Disease)
Plasma_dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = pro_dat[,56:87],
                                     colData = coldata[55:86,],design = ~Disease)
FFPE_dds <- DESeq(FFPE_dds,parallel = T)
FFPE_vst<-varianceStabilizingTransformation(FFPE_dds)
PBMC_dds <- DESeq(PBMC_dds,parallel = T)
PBMC_vst<-varianceStabilizingTransformation(PBMC_dds)
Plasma_dds <- DESeq(Plasma_dds,parallel = T)
Plasma_vst<-varianceStabilizingTransformation(Plasma_dds)
# creat deseq objects for HR analysis using the same size factors, the vst counts will also be different by different disign.
FFPE_HR <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = pro_dat[,10:23],
                                   colData = coldata[9:22,],design = ~Disease+HR+Disease:HR)
PBMC_HR <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = pro_dat[,40:55],
                                   colData = coldata[39:54,],design = ~Disease+HR+Disease:HR)
Plasma_HR <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = pro_dat[,72:87],
                                   colData = coldata[71:86,],design = ~Disease+HR+Disease:HR)
sizeFactors(FFPE_HR) <- sizeFactors(FFPE_dds)[9:22]
sizeFactors(PBMC_HR) <- sizeFactors(PBMC_dds)[17:32]
sizeFactors(Plasma_HR) <- sizeFactors(Plasma_dds)[17:32]
FFPE_HR <- DESeq(FFPE_HR,parallel = T)
FFPE_HR_vst <- varianceStabilizingTransformation(FFPE_HR)
PBMC_HR <- DESeq(PBMC_HR,parallel = T)
PBMC_HR_vst <- varianceStabilizingTransformation(PBMC_HR)
Plasma_HR <- DESeq(Plasma_HR,parallel = T)
Plasma_HR_vst <- varianceStabilizingTransformation(Plasma_HR)
#sncRNA DE
snc_dat<-dat[dat$Type=="sncRNA"|dat$Type=="miRNA",]
snc_dat$Type2<-droplevels(snc_dat$Type2)
FFPE_snc_dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = snc_dat[,2:23], 
                                       colData = coldata[1:22,],design = ~Disease)
PBMC_snc_dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = snc_dat[,24:55], 
                                       colData = coldata[23:54,],design = ~Disease)
Plasma_snc_dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = snc_dat[,56:87], 
                                         colData = coldata[55:86,],design = ~Disease)
FFPE_snc_dds <- DESeq(FFPE_snc_dds,parallel = T)
FFPE_snc_vst<-varianceStabilizingTransformation(FFPE_snc_dds)
PBMC_snc_dds <- DESeq(PBMC_snc_dds,parallel = T)
PBMC_snc_vst<-varianceStabilizingTransformation(PBMC_snc_dds)
Plasma_snc_dds <- DESeq(Plasma_snc_dds,parallel = T)
Plasma_snc_vst<-varianceStabilizingTransformation(Plasma_snc_dds)

FFPE_snc_HR <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = snc_dat[,10:23],
                                     colData = coldata[9:22,],design = ~Disease+HR+Disease:HR)
PBMC_snc_HR <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = snc_dat[,40:55],
                                     colData = coldata[39:54,],design = ~Disease+HR+Disease:HR)
Plasma_snc_HR <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = snc_dat[,72:87],
                                       colData = coldata[71:86,],design = ~Disease+HR+Disease:HR)
sizeFactors(FFPE_snc_HR) <- sizeFactors(FFPE_snc_dds)[9:22]
sizeFactors(PBMC_snc_HR) <- sizeFactors(PBMC_snc_dds)[17:32]
sizeFactors(Plasma_snc_HR) <- sizeFactors(Plasma_snc_dds)[17:32]
FFPE_snc_HR <- DESeq(FFPE_snc_HR,parallel = T)
FFPE_snc_HR_vst <- varianceStabilizingTransformation(FFPE_snc_HR)
PBMC_snc_HR <- DESeq(PBMC_snc_HR,parallel = T)
PBMC_snc_HR_vst <- varianceStabilizingTransformation(PBMC_snc_HR)
Plasma_snc_HR <- DESeq(Plasma_snc_HR,parallel = T)
Plasma_snc_HR_vst <- varianceStabilizingTransformation(Plasma_snc_HR)

#function for volcano plot
plot_volcano<-function(dat_non_sig,dat_sig,x_lim,y_lim,xlab_seq,
                       ylab_seq,title,type,leg_posx,leg_posy){
  plot(dat_non_sig$log2FoldChange, -log10(dat_non_sig$padj),xlim=x_lim,ylim=y_lim,
       main=title, xlab=bquote(log[2](FC)),xaxt="n",bty="n", yaxt="n",
       ylab=bquote("-"*log[10]*"(adjusted p-value)"),col=mcol[1],
       pch=20, cex=0.7)
  axis(side = 1,at = xlab_seq,labels = xlab_seq)
  axis(side = 2,labels = ylab_seq,at = ylab_seq,las=1)
  abline(v=0, col="black", lty=3, lwd=1.0)
  abline(v=-2, col="black", lty=4, lwd=2.0)
  abline(v=2, col="black", lty=4, lwd=2.0)
  abline(h=-log10(0.001), col="black", lty=3, lwd=2.0)
  if (type=="pro"){
    points(dat_sig$log2FoldChange,-log10(dat_sig$padj), pch=20, col=mcol[2], cex=0.7)
    legend(leg_posx,leg_posy,pch=20,bty="n",col=c(mcol,"white"),
           legend =c("Non-significant",as.expression(bquote("|"*log[2]*"(FC)|">=2)),
                     as.expression(bquote(padj<=0.001))),cex=0.7)
  } else if (type=="snc") {
    points(dat_sig$log2FoldChange,-log10(dat_sig$padj), pch=21, 
           bg=scol[dat_sig$Type2], cex=0.7,lwd=0.5)
    legend(leg_posx,leg_posy,pch=21,bty="n",pt.bg=c(mcol[1],scol),cex=0.7,pt.lwd = 0.5,
           legend =c("Non-significant",levels(dat_sig$Type2)))
  }
}
mcol<-c("black","red")
scol<-brewer.pal(9, "Set1")
pcol<-brewer.pal(4,"Paired")
#simplified volcano for TIFF output
plot_volcanoS<-function(dat_non_sig,dat_sig,x_lim,y_lim,xlab_seq,ylab_seq,type){
  plot(dat_non_sig$log2FoldChange, -log10(dat_non_sig$padj),xlim=x_lim,ylim=y_lim,
       main=NA, xlab=NA,xaxt="n",bty="n", yaxt="n",
       ylab=NA,col=mcol[1],
       pch=20, cex=0.2)
  axis(side = 1,at = xlab_seq,labels = NA,tck=-0.02,lwd=0.5)
  axis(side = 2,labels = NA,at = ylab_seq,las=1,tck=-0.02,lwd=0.5)
  abline(v=0, col="black", lty=3, lwd=0.5)
  abline(v=-2, col="black", lty=4, lwd=0.5)
  abline(v=2, col="black", lty=4, lwd=0.5)
  abline(h=-log10(0.001), col="black", lty=3, lwd=0.5)
  if (type=="pro"){
    points(dat_sig$log2FoldChange,-log10(dat_sig$padj), pch=20, col=mcol[2], cex=0.2)
  } else if (type=="snc") {
    points(dat_sig$log2FoldChange,-log10(dat_sig$padj), pch=21, 
           bg=scol[dat_sig$Type2], cex=0.2,lwd=0.2)
  }
}
```

```{r}
# generate results for pair-wise comparason
# Between diseases/tissues/HR
# function of generate results
# Combins all result dataframes to a list
res_convert<-function(comp_arg, pro_odj, snc_obj){
  res<-data.frame(results(pro_odj,contrast = comp_arg, alpha = 0.05))
  res<-cbind(res,pro_dat[,c(1,89)])
  res_snc<-data.frame(results(snc_obj,contrast = comp_arg, alpha = 0.05))
  res_snc<-cbind(res_snc,snc_dat[,c(1,89)])
  res<-rbind(res,res_snc)
  res<-res[complete.cases(res),]
  res$log10padj<-log10(1/res$padj)
  return(res)
}
#  01-06, FFPE_dds and FFPE_snc_dds
# 01. Frozen tissue; nonIBC vs Healthy (4:4)
comp <- c("Disease","F_nonIBC","Healthy")
comp_res<-list(res_01=res_convert(comp, FFPE_dds, FFPE_snc_dds))

# 02 FFPE; IBC vs nonIBC (10:4)
comp <- c("Disease","IBC","nonIBC")
comp_res$res_02<-res_convert(comp, FFPE_dds, FFPE_snc_dds)

# 03 FFPE IBC vs Frozen Healthy (10:4)
comp <- c("Disease","IBC","Healthy")
comp_res$res_03<-res_convert(comp, FFPE_dds, FFPE_snc_dds)

# 04 FFPE IBC vs Frozen nonIBC (10:4)
comp <- c("Disease","IBC","F_nonIBC")
comp_res$res_04<-res_convert(comp, FFPE_dds, FFPE_snc_dds)

# 05 FFPE nonIBC vs Frozen Healthy (4:4)
comp <- c("Disease","nonIBC","Healthy")
comp_res$res_05<-res_convert(comp, FFPE_dds, FFPE_snc_dds)

# 06 FFPE nonIBC vs Frozen nonIBC (4:4)
comp <- c("Disease","nonIBC","F_nonIBC")
comp_res$res_06<-res_convert(comp, FFPE_dds, FFPE_snc_dds)

# 07-09, PBMC_dds and PBMC_snc_dds
# 07 PBMC IBC vs Healthy (10:16)
comp <- c("Disease","IBC","Healthy")
comp_res$res_07<-res_convert(comp, PBMC_dds, PBMC_snc_dds)

# 08 PBMC IBC vs nonIBC (10:6)
comp <- c("Disease","IBC","nonIBC")
comp_res$res_08<-res_convert(comp, PBMC_dds, PBMC_snc_dds)

# 09 PBMC nonIBC vs Healthy (6:16)
comp <- c("Disease","nonIBC","Healthy")
comp_res$res_09<-res_convert(comp, PBMC_dds, PBMC_snc_dds)

# 10-12, Plasma_dds and Plasma_snc_dds
# 10 Plasma IBC vs Healthy (10:16)
comp <- c("Disease","IBC","Healthy")
comp_res$res_10<-res_convert(comp, Plasma_dds, Plasma_snc_dds)

# 11 Plasma IBC vs nonIBC (10:6)
comp <- c("Disease","IBC","nonIBC")
comp_res$res_11<-res_convert(comp, Plasma_dds, Plasma_snc_dds)

# 12 Plasma nonIBC vs Healthy (6:16)
comp <- c("Disease","nonIBC","Healthy")
comp_res$res_12<-res_convert(comp, Plasma_dds, Plasma_snc_dds)

# HR results HR+ vs HR-
# HR_01, FFPE nonIBC
# as shown by resultsNames, the main effect is HR+ vs HR- in nonIBC
comp <- c("HR","P","N")
comp_res$HR_01 <- res_convert(comp, FFPE_HR, FFPE_snc_HR)
# HR_02, FFPE IBC
# use the list of contrast to get IBC HR+ vs HR-
comp <- list(c("HR_P_vs_N","DiseaseIBC.HRP"))
comp_res$HR_02 <- res_convert(comp, FFPE_HR, FFPE_snc_HR)

# HR_03, PBMC nonIBC
comp <- c("HR","P","N")
comp_res$HR_03 <- res_convert(comp, PBMC_HR, PBMC_snc_HR)
# HR_04, PBMC IBC
comp <- list(c("HR_P_vs_N","DiseaseIBC.HRP"))
comp_res$HR_04 <- res_convert(comp, PBMC_HR, PBMC_snc_HR)

# HR_05, Plasma nonIBC
comp <- c("HR","P","N")
comp_res$HR_05 <- res_convert(comp, Plasma_HR, Plasma_snc_HR)
# HR_06, Plasma IBC
comp <- list(c("HR_P_vs_N","DiseaseIBC.HRP"))
comp_res$HR_06 <- res_convert(comp, Plasma_HR, Plasma_snc_HR)

# combined vst counts for heatmap
comp_vst<-list(FFPE=rbind(assay(FFPE_vst),assay(FFPE_snc_vst)))
comp_vst$PBMC<-rbind(assay(PBMC_vst),assay(PBMC_snc_vst))
comp_vst$Plasma<-rbind(assay(Plasma_vst),assay(Plasma_snc_vst))
comp_vst$FFPE_HR<-rbind(assay(FFPE_HR_vst),assay(FFPE_snc_HR_vst))
comp_vst$PBMC_HR<-rbind(assay(PBMC_HR_vst),assay(PBMC_snc_HR_vst))
comp_vst$Plasma_HR<-rbind(assay(Plasma_HR_vst),assay(Plasma_snc_HR_vst))

save.image("IBC.image")
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
mat[,1:14]<-mat[,1:14]-rowMeans(mat[,1:14])

         fontsize_row =5, cluster_cols = F,labels_row = mat$Name, show_colnames = F)
dev.off()

mat$Type2<-relevel(mat$Type2,"Protein coding")
mat1<-mat[mat$log2FoldChange>0,]
mat1<-mat1[order(mat1$Type2),]
mat2<-mat[mat$log2FoldChange<0,]
mat2<-mat2[order(mat2$Type2),]
mat<-rbind(mat1,mat2)
pdf(paste0(file_name[17],"_heatmap.pdf"),height=18,width=6)
pheatmap(as.matrix(mat[,1:6]), annotation_col = coldata[,1:2],cluster_rows = F,
         fontsize_row =5, cluster_cols = F,labels_row = mat$Name, show_colnames = F)
dev.off()
```
